title: Headset Cue Check
user: Screen-reader users and accessibility staff evaluating a headset for speech, stereo, mono, level, and notification workflows.
smallest_useful_product: An offline accessible web test that runs labelled speech, stereo/mono, level, and interruption scenarios; records only user ratings and produces a local setup card with the exact OS settings to revisit.
constraints: Fully keyboard and screen-reader operable; ratings stay local; not an audiology test; browser audio routing is limited.
